text:
Maya (partnerships): Heads up — we need to lock the runway for the new APAC edge region (ap-southeast4) with CloudWave. Primary asks: marketplace SKU + pricing, quota request to partner, KMS gating, and a joint announcement window. Who's got ETA?

Liam (cloudops): I filed the initial quota request yesterday to CloudWave portal — reference CW-REQ-2042. They asked for a detailed sizing profile. I pushed our expected steady-state: 24 vGPUs (8 x pod pools), burst to 40 for holiday promo. ETA from them ~7 business days once we send profile.

Tom (sales): FYI we've already committed to two pilot customers that want early access mid-quarter. If CloudWave approval slips >2 weeks we need to offer a soft SLA or keep them on Dedicated fallback. @Maya can we delay announcement until pilot greenlight? :thinking_face:

Maya (partnerships): Good call. Proposal: gating criteria = (1) partner approves quota, (2) KMS integration verified, (3) marketplace SKU live in test catalog, (4) two pilot customers onboarded. If any fail, move to canary-only launch.

Anita (legal): For marketplace we need the updated MSA addendum (CloudWave marketplace terms) and a data residency appendix for APAC. I reviewed the draft — there are 3 redlines around export controls and logging retention. I can push the redlines today but need a sign-off from cloud-partner legal. Timeline: 3–5 business days after we send.

Sophie (eng-ml): From runtime side the model packaging is fine, but we need to validate GPU kernel fallback for the smaller nodes CloudWave exposes in that region. I spun a smoke test that fails when KV cache > 6GB — attaching the quick commands we ran:```bash
# smoke test (run on staging cluster)
kubectl apply -f examples/ap-southeast4-smoketest.yaml
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/serve --data '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Failure mode: OOM on liveness probe at ~1.2k tokens. I can try a quantized config if Ops can provision one extra mem-optimized instance.

Liam (cloudops): Noted. I can ask CloudWave for one mem-optimized SKU (m.gpu.xlarge) in the quota request (addendum). If they approve, we can run Sophie’s smoke tests pre-marketplace. I added a note in CW-REQ-2042.

Tom (sales): About joint announcement — marketing wants a soft date: target week of 2026-05-11. Can we realistically hit that? If legal + quota + runtime checks all hit minimums, yes. Otherwise we push.

Maya (partnerships): Tentative plan: target 2026-05-11 announcement, freeze comms assets 2026-05-04. Action items: Liam to update quota with mem SKU + final numbers (due 3156792000), Anita to send redlines to partner legal (due 3156795600), Sophie to validate smoke test on mem SKU (due 3156797400), Tom to prep customer comms + fallback messaging (due 3156797400).

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: marketplace-integration branch build succeeded (artifact: marketplace-apac-v1.2). Link: https://ci.redwood/builds/9842 :white_check_mark:

Liam (cloudops): I'll update CW-REQ-2042 now. Also will ping partner AM for expedited review.

Anita (legal): Sending redlines to partner legal in 30m. Will flag anything that blocks the announcement.

Sophie (eng-ml): Once mem SKU is available I'll re-run the smoke and post results here. If OOM persists I'll try a 4-bit quantization run and report perf delta.

Maya (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll sync with marketing on contingency messaging today and set a short follow-up on Friday to confirm gating status. :raised_hands:
